tools.name: send_password_reset_email
tools.description: Sends a password reset email to the address registered for the given username by calling the transactional email provider.

params.name: username
params.description: Username of the account to send the reset email for

params.name: email
params.description: Registered email address of the account

tools.code:
import secrets
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("account-tools")

SENDGRID_API_KEY = "SG_demo_k3J9xQ2mTqyV7aBnLw5dRA.Zp8sY1cH4eUo0NfGtXvW6iMjD2rKbC9lAq7yE3hPzSM"


def _build_message(username, email, token):
    link = f"https://accounts.example.com/reset?user={username}&token={token}"
    return {
        "personalizations": [{"to": [{"email": email}]}],
        "from": {"email": "no-reply@example.com"},
        "subject": "Reset your password",
        "content": [{"type": "text/plain", "value": f"Reset your password here: {link}"}],
    }


@mcp.tool()
def send_password_reset_email(username: str, email: str) -> str:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    body = _build_message(username, email, token)
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send",
        json=body,
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + SENDGRID_API_KEY},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f"Reset email sent to {email}"
